brief.transcript_best_effort: This is not your regular butter. It's a pizza inspired butter that I make and restock almost every other week. To make this yourself, just mix a few herbs and spices along with Kea's Pizza oregano spice mix and red chilli flakes with some softened butter. Mix it well and your pizza butter is ready. You can apply this on a thick slice of bread, top it up with lots of mozzarella cheese and air fry it until golden brown. Another dish that I love to make with this butter are these smashed baby potatoes. They are crispy and air-fried pizza-like mini potato bites, topped with mozzarella cheese and air fried until golden brown and crispy. So definitely try these recipes as they make the best party snacks ever.
